blocks.html: Notwithstanding the applicant's election to use the 1968 Building Code or prior code, the structural calculations shall be permitted to be performed in accordance with this code provided that the structural safety of the prior code building is not reduced. Notwithstanding the provisions of Section 28-101.4.4 of the Administrative Code, the use of Load and Resistance Factor Design (LRFD) engineering calculations shall not be deemed to reduce structural safety provided the properties of the existing materials are determined using accepted engineering principles.
